subject: Next steps & economic buyer intro — Redwood demo follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Jenkins <laura.jenkins@acmecorp.com>, Tom Alvarez <t.alvarez@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for the time — quick recap & next step (economic buyer intro)

Hi Laura / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side:

- Primary goal: reduce inference cost for customer-facing NLP features while keeping 99thpct latency under 350ms.
- Current pain: unpredictable token costs and opaque latency spikes during peak traffic.
- Key success metrics you called out: 30% reduction in per-token costs and predictable SLOs for peak windows.

Next steps we discussed:
1) Intro to your economic buyer / budget owner so we can align on pricing model and procurement timeline.
2) Technical follow-up with Vivek to confirm security/compliance constraints (SOC2, data residency).
3) Mutual action plan + draft SOW for procurement to review.

Could you confirm who owns the budget and whether we should loop in legal/procurement now or after the pricing discussion? I attached the latest intro deck and a placeholder SOW to give procurement a head start.

Suggested times for a 30-min intro call (PST): Wed 6/17 10:00–11:00 or Thu 6/18 9:00–11:30. Happy to work around your schedule.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0199
Attachments: Redwood_Intro_Deck_v3.pdf, SOW_draft_acme_v1.docx
From: Laura Jenkins <laura.jenkins@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <t.alvarez@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Thanks for the time — quick recap & next step (economic buyer intro)

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the summary — that matches our notes. Short answers to your questions:

- Economic buyer is Dan Murray (VP Finance). I'll loop him in below.
- Budget owner / procurement lead is Karen Holt (Dir. Procurement) — she handles vendor contracts and PO timing.
- Legal will likely want to review the security questionnaire; happy to share your questionnaire with them once you confirm it's the latest version.

I attached a short doc with our expected procurement timelines and a note on data residency for our EU traffic.

Wed 6/17 is tight for Dan — Thu 6/18 morning PST should work. Can you do Thu 6/18 at 10:30 PST?

Thanks,
Laura
Head of Product Integrations | Acme Corp
laura.jenkins@acmecorp.com
Attachment: ACME_procurement_timeline.pdf

Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Redwood <> Acme — align on pricing & procurement (Thu 6/18 10:30 PST)

Dan / Karen —

Thanks for joining this thread — Laura gave a great overview of the opportunity. Per Laura, we scheduled a short intro for Thu 6/18 at 10:30 PST to align on pricing, procurement timeline, and legal/security steps.

Quick context: Redwood is an inference platform optimized for predictable token economics and low-latency serving across hosted and private deployments. For Acme, we believe a Dedicated or hybrid routing policy could give you the cost predictability you asked for while meeting latency SLOs.

Attachments: I re-attached our intro deck and a draft SOW to help procurement review. Vivek will be on the call to cover security / architecture. Rishi will cover pricing and commercial model.

Agenda (15–30 min):
- 5 min: quick intros + success criteria
- 10–15 min: pricing model and procurement timing
- 5–10 min: next steps (security questionnaire, mutual action plan, estimate)

If that time works, I'll send a calendar invite now & include a short MAP link.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Intro_Deck_v3.pdf, SOW_draft_acme_v1.docx
MAP: https://redwood.app/map/ACME-2026-54

Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood <> Acme — align on pricing & procurement (Thu 6/18 10:30 PST)

Marissa / team —

Thanks for the intro and context. 10:30 PST on Thu works for me. A couple quick notes from finance/procurement side:

- Budget window is Q3 planning; we need a rough TCO and a sample PO by mid-July to include in our planning.
- Please loop in procurement@acmecorp.com for contract/legal cadence — Karen is the internal owner but procurement manages the PO process.
- For security: we typically require an executed NDA and our vendor security questionnaire (I can send the form after the call).

Looking forward to the call.

Dan Murray
VP Finance | Acme Corp
dan.murray@acmecorp.com
